mapper.select: SELECT FROM store_opening_category c ORDER BY c.depth,c.sort_order,c.category_code
SELECT FROM store_opening_category c WHERE c.category_code=#{code}
SELECT FROM store_opening_category c WHERE c.category_code=#{code} FOR UPDATE

SELECT FROM store_opening_category c LEFT JOIN store_opening_category p ON p.category_code=c.parent_code WHERE c.category_code=#{code} AND c.node_kind='BRANCH' AND c.enabled AND (p.category_code IS NULL OR p.enabled) FOR SHARE
mapper.update: UPDATE store_opening_category SET name=#{input.name},sort_order=#{input.sortOrder},enabled=#{input.enabled}, version=version+1 WHERE category_code=#{code} AND version=#{input.expectedVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT version,name,sort_order,enabled,actor_id,reason,changed_at FROM platform_category_history WHERE category_code=#{code} ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM platform_category_curator WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND actor_id=#{actor} AND active)
SELECT active FROM platform_category_curator WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND actor_id=#{actor} FOR SHARE
